Stop holding projects at a revision.

Removes spec.revision from the manifest of each named project, so the next slipway sync fast-forwards its branch onto its upstream again. The repository is left as it is. A project without spec.revision prints not pinned.

Examples:
  # Let project hldr follow its upstream again
  slipway rollout unpin hldr

Usage:
  slipway rollout unpin (NAME... | project/NAME...) [flags]

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
